title: Live role detail: output tail and tokens/cost in the run pane

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S07 (landed) delivered the stage bar, ticker and sparkline, but not the output tail or tokens and cost that its title promised. Owner 2026-10-24: tail and tokens/cost in v1; the bell moves to v1.1 (S100). Today tokens and cost are recorded per role round when it ends (runrec.RoleRecord, internal/runrec/record.go:61-62; engine.Result Tokens and CostUSD, internal/engine/runner.go:64-65), so a running role shows neither; the claude adapter keeps a 2 KB tail per round (internal/agent/claude/run.go:20-21, Round.Tail) but nothing streams it to the TUI. The tail can contain secrets (a recorded command can, see S51): it must stay in daemon memory, never in run.json.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/runner.go:64-65` (Request): keep `OnEvent func()`; add a sibling `OnLive func(Live)` with {Text string, Tokens int}.
- `internal/daemon/runner.go:21-47` (claude) and `internal/daemon/runner.go:79-93` (codex): map adapter events to OnLive, and redact there (it holds `r.env`) before text enters the ring.
- `internal/agent/claude/stream.go:46-90` (ParseLine maps only text_delta and the final result; parse message_start and message_delta usage, see `testdata/vendors/claude/02-stream-json.stdout`) and `internal/agent/claude/run.go:20-21`.
- `internal/agent/codex/codex.go:99-190`: Codex has no text deltas; it emits whole `item.completed` agent messages (:166) and `turn.completed` usage (:174-176).
- `internal/engine/activity.go`: tail and live tokens beside the activity ring, memory only, same mutex.
- `internal/runrec/record.go:61-62`; `internal/source/source.go:176` (EngineRun); `internal/daemon/runs.go:902` (engineRuns; activity read :967, constructor :980): `tail`, `tokens`, `cost_usd` as *proposed* fields.
- `internal/tui/pane.go:88` (paneLines), `internal/tui/runtree.go`, `internal/tui/relayboard.go`, `internal/tui/overview.go`.
- Tests beside each; goldens `testdata/golden/pane-tail-*.txt`; `docs/dashboard.md`, `docs/design.md`, `docs/state.md` (the tail is never written to disk).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestTailKeepsTheLastBytesOfVisibleText: text deltas fill a ring capped at 2 KB; older text is dropped; the ring is reset at each new role round.
- TestTailNeverReachesRunJSON: the run record and report files contain no tail text.
- TestLiveTokensAndCostAccumulate: usage events update the running totals before the round ends; the final Result still sets the RoleRecord values.
- TestPaneShowsTheTailAndTokens: the running node shows up to 3 dim tail lines clipped to the pane width and `tokens N  $C`; a finished role shows its recorded values; no tail for stopped or ended runs.
- TestRunningRowShowsTheTokenTotal and the narrow-row drop order (bar and heard stay first to go).
- TestAdaptersMapTextAndUsageEvents (claude and codex fixtures).
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Do a spec preflight: check how each adapter exposes text deltas and usage mid-round (claude --include-partial-messages; codex per item) and list gaps. 2. Write the failing tests first. 3. Keep the tail and counters in memory beside the activity ring. 4. Carry them on the snapshot. 5. Draw them. 6. Update the docs. 7. go test ./internal/tui -update and review the golden diff. This is a UI slice: it gets the UI pass (r14, rule u10). Open for the preflight to settle with the owner: how many tail lines, whether the tail shows tool calls or only assistant text, and a redaction rule. Decided 2026-10-24 (owner): tail and tokens/cost in v1; bell to v1.1.

Owner decisions (2026-10-25 batch spec check, all recommended options): (1) hook: keep OnEvent func(), add OnLive func(Live{Text, Tokens}). (2) cost: tokens accumulate live; cost is set when the round ends ($- until then); TestLiveTokensAndCostAccumulate becomes "tokens accumulate; cost is set at the end". (3) tail: assistant text only; Codex shows whole messages at item end, not deltas; say so in docs/dashboard.md. (4) 3 tail lines, clipped lines end with an ellipsis. (5) redaction: mask run-env values whose variable name contains KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD or CREDENTIAL and whose value is 8 or more characters, replaced by ***, in internal/daemon/runner.go. Live token sums use each vendor's final sum (claude: input+output+cache read+cache creation, daemon/runner.go:46; codex: input+output, codex.go:176); check that summed per-message usage matches the result event and say so if not. Narrow Running row: the token total drops before heard (existing order docs/dashboard.md:195). Note: the bell already exists in the Model (internal/tui/model.go apply, m.cfg.Bell); S100's premise needs checking.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/source ./internal/tui ./internal/agent/...
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] While a relay runs, the pane shows a live tail and the token and cost totals, and a stopped run shows no tail.
